summary: Ares Capital Corporation filed an 8-K reporting entry into a Seventh Supplemental Indenture with U.S. Bank Trust Company, National Association, covering the issuance, offer and sale of $750 million aggregate principal amount of 6.250% unsecured notes due September 15, 2033. Interest is payable semiannually starting March 15, 2027, and the notes are redeemable at the company's option. Net proceeds are expected to repay credit facility borrowings, which may be reborrowed for general corporate purposes including portfolio company investments. This is a routine debt issuance rather than a special situation.
